query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 629 AND 633),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 629 AND 633),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 629 AND 633),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 629 AND 633),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 629 AND 633),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0629-0633:%'),'search_documents',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type='fact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_facts f WHERE f.id=d.entity_id AND f.source_page BETWEEN 629 AND 633)) OR (d.entity_type='note' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_notes n WHERE n.id=d.entity_id AND n.source_page BETWEEN 629 AND 633))),'bad_mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 629 AND 633),'invalid_verification_statuses',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 629 AND 633 AND verification_status NOT IN ('verified','source_attributed','conflicting','unverified','rejected')),'orphan_batch_assignments',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a WHERE a.assigned_by='batch-0629-0633-quality-pipeline' AND ((a.entity_type='fact' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_facts f WHERE f.id=a.entity_id)) OR (a.entity_type='note' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_notes n WHERE n.id=a.entity_id)))),'invalid_batch_tag_categories',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a JOIN public.content_tags t ON t.id=a.tag_id WHERE a.assigned_by='batch-0629-0633-quality-pipeline' AND t.category NOT IN ('domain','content_type','theme','exam_source','quality'))) AS integrity LIMIT 1;
